description: This file defines the 'NoteDetailScreen' React functional component for a React Native app. It provides UI and logic to view, edit, save, delete, and tag notes as part of a note-taking application. It interacts with external services to fetch and modify note data and manages internal state for note attributes and tags.

methods.name: NoteDetailScreen
methods.description: React component for editing note details including title, content, and tags with save and delete actions.
